title: [Minor bug] Allowed access after door is sold

posts.author: Alexander
posts.title: [Minor bug] Allowed access after door is sold
posts.html:
Hey. This is just a small issue but I wasn't sure if you knew about this or not so I figured it's better to have more information than to have too little, even if it isn't worth taking a look at.

If you buy a door, and then add other people to the access list, then sell the door, the people on the access list can still lock and unlock the door.

Example:

Yakuza says: yo biatch letzz goo
Yakuza buys an apartment and adds Alexander to the list of people that have access to it (allowing me to lock or unlock the door).
Yakuza says: shet i piz me paantyes cu latr
Yakuza exits the game (the door becomes available for purchase again).
Alexander can still lock and unlock the door, even though no one owns it.
